title: Dune Messiah
author: Frank Herbert
summary: Twelve years after taking the throne, Paul rules an empire swept by a religious war carried out in his name. Old enemies and a handful of insiders plot to bring him down.
readIf: you finished Dune and want the sharp, sombre follow-up about what power does to a hero.
skipIf: you want more desert adventure, since this is shorter, talkier and more of a tragedy than a sequel in spirit.

pairings.reason: Read this first, since the sequel's weight depends on what the original set up.
Another dense far-future work about religion, power and an empire sliding toward ruin.
